one_liner: AI meeting recorder and notetaker with a REST API for meetings, transcripts, summaries, teams and webhooks.
notes: API keys generated in User Settings (X-Api-Key) plus OAuth 2.0 apps registered self-serve at fathom.video/marketplace_applications/new (Bearer). FAQ: API keys and webhooks are included on all plans; pricing shows a Free-forever plan -> self_serve_free. OAuth apps are 'subject to review', but the docs tie review to marketplace promotion/listing and registration yields credentials in minutes, so ready rather than ready_with_review. API is mostly read (meetings, transcripts, summaries, downloads, teams, users) plus webhook create/delete -> narrow. Official MCP documented at developers.fathom.ai/mcp-docs (pricing page lists MCP integrations under paid tiers; that does not change the mcp label).

evidence.quote: All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated via the Fathom website's settings area.
Both TypeScript and Python SDKs support OAuth 2.0 authentication for building integrations that can be installed by multiple Fathom accounts.
This documentation describes Fathom's REST API.
API access—keys and webhooks— are included on all plans.
Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.
Head to the API Access section of your User Settings and generate an API key.
